latest.title: Identify and Optimize NAT Gateway Traffic Using VPC Flow Logs and DNS Query Logs
latest.description:
As NAT Gateway traffic grows, a portion of it is destined for AWS services
  or SaaS providers that could be reached more cost-effectively — and
  privately — through VPC Endpoints or PrivateLink, but flow logs alone only
  show raw destination IPs, making it hard to know what's worth moving.
  This guide shows a serverless approach: enable VPC Flow Logs and Route 53
  DNS query logs for a few days, then use Amazon Athena to produce a ranked
  list of your NAT destinations resolved to real domain names.
